senses.gloss_en: to unmask (to remove a mask from someone)
deforestation (thinning or cleaning of bush on land, area, etc.)
to clear (to fell all trees of a forest)
to dismember (to cut off the limbs of a body)
to disjoin, to disunite, to separate
demining, mine-clearing (the process of removing and neutralizing mines)
demotivation (feeling or state of being demotivated)
demotivator (one who, or that which, demotivates)
